minimum_change: Exact only when every smaller feasible deletion cardinality is excluded; otherwise report lower/upper bounds and a common deletion witness.
welch_bounds: Exact rational mean intervals and enclosing variance intervals; univariate minimum-variance windows give a safe variance floor. No new two-group extremum theorem or priority claim.
model_scope: Observed refits only; fixed input feature filter, explicit contrast/covariates, normalization and model re-estimated per scenario, failed fits retained as NOT_EVALUABLE.
single_cell: Sum raw nonnegative integer counts by sample and cell type; donor is the deletion unit; cell counts and exclusions recorded; no cell-level pseudoreplication.

validation.stable_synthetic_cases: Separated features fixed before execution, plus ties, zero variance and difficult near-boundary cases.
validation.no_result_rescue: Preserve changed, unresolved, failed-fit and empty-universe outcomes; report provider preprocessing, no biomarker or clinical claims.
